scope: Executed CPU, controlled DOM and native Canvas. Browser navigation is tested separately.

checks.name: Checkpoints round-trip all 115 fighter identities without touching dossier slots
Corrupted newest checkpoint recovers the other slot and repairs the broken one
A terminal tombstone prevents resurrection of a completed or failed run
Checksum damage, malformed JSON and oversized imports do not alter the valid checkpoint
Invalid health, counters, routes, difficulty and unknown creatures are rejected
Imported profiles are reconstructed from a whitelist, not merged into prototypes
Stale tabs detect a changed storage head and refuse to overwrite it
Unavailable storage and unconfirmed writes return explicit failures
Bench executes all 1150 real move startups with no reward or result channel
Bench tick count is independent from playback speed and rendering
Directional command selection stays relative to the opponent on both sides
Laboratory controls initialize and step the real engine without navigation or saving
All 460 finisher entries are reachable exactly once and filtering retains four per specimen
An interrupted operation resumes its identical opponent, seed and starting health after reload
A real victory stores the next encounter; reload cannot grant that victory twice
Reversed winner-slot identities and zero-life winners cannot change progression
A real replay carries the runtime contract and mismatches are rejected before state changes
Checkpoint import rejects invalid data without interrupting a running duel
Production serves packaged assets without redirecting them to an obsolete deployment
